text: Judi Health, formerly named Capital Rx, Inc., is a private US health-technology company founded in late 2017 by Chief Executive Officer AJ Loiacono and Chief Technology Officer Ryan Kelly; in September 2025 it announced a $400 million investment including a $252 million Series F round led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst.
short: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx): private US company founded by AJ Loiacono and Ryan Kelly; 2025 round led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst.
